verdict.rationale: Forter documents an end-to-end automated dispute pipeline: webhook-based chargeback ingestion (forward-chargebacks.md), a recommendation engine that suggests evidence (automate-evidence.md), a Request-for-Evidence webhook naming needed evidence types, and an Evidence API to automatically submit post-order evidence without manual copy-paste, plus order/status data feeding into decisions. Missing for 10: explicit mention of session-data inclusion in evidence packages and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond first-party docs.
